name: Answering a question advances the progress bar and counter
description: Selecting an answer on the Solstice take page advances the question counter and grows the progress bar, then shows the next question.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice take page
Verify the progress indicator reads '1 of 36' and a thin horizontal progress bar is shown nearly empty at the top of the content area.
Click one of the seven numbered answer options for the first question
Verify the progress indicator advances to '2 of 36', the progress bar has grown visibly wider than before, and a different question prompt is now displayed.
